title: Compute reference electronic structure of pure Si₃N₄
action: Using the tight‑binding parameters for Si₃N₄ and the cluster Bethe Lattice model for the perfect network, compute the average density of states (DOS) and local DOS for each atom type. Determine the valence band top (Ev_Si3N4) from the computed DOS.
description: Establishes the valence band edge of defect‑free Si₃N₄. The evidence file contains the computed DOS and the derived Ev_Si3N4.

title: Compute reference electronic structure of pure SiO₂
action: Using the tight‑binding parameters for SiO₂ and the cluster Bethe Lattice model for the perfect network, compute the average density of states (DOS) and local DOS for each atom type. Determine the valence band top (Ev_SiO2) from the computed DOS.
description: Establishes the valence band edge of defect‑free SiO₂. The evidence file contains the computed DOS and the derived Ev_SiO2.

title: Compute defect state energies for Si dangling bond and Si—Si bond in Si₃N₄, Si₃N₄:O, SiO₂, and SiO₂:N
action: Construct cluster Bethe Lattice models for each defect configuration... (full action as in instruction.md edit) ... Write the eight energies (in eV) to defect_energies.json.
description: Contains the eight defect‑state energies that are the main numerical results for the Si₃N₄ / Si₃N₄:O and SiO₂ / SiO₂:N calculations.
